test_policy.notes: Frostburg is test optional: submitted SAT/ACT scores are considered but do not hurt an application, and applicants without scores get full consideration, including for merit scholarships.

requirements.notes: $45 non-refundable fee (a waiver may be provided through the applicant's high school). Personal statement and 1-2 recommendation letters are optional. International applicants also submit a course-by-course foreign credential evaluation of all transcripts (ECE, ICDE, Josef Silney or WES), a financial certification form with a bank statement showing support for one year, a passport copy and proof of English proficiency. International students cannot use payment plans.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Page says 'apply by June 1st for Fall and October 15th for Spring' to allow time for visa processing; the page gives no year, so 2027 is assumed. Domestic applications open August 1 and are accepted until space runs out.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Domestic first-year page: apply by November 15 for a decision in 2-4 weeks; regular applications are 'encouraged by February 1'. The page gives no year, so the fall 2027 cycle is assumed. International applicants have the June 1 deadline above.

deadlines.label: Foundation scholarship priority deadline
deadlines.notes: Foundation scholarship applications are accepted until August 1. The year is not printed, so 2027 is assumed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Proof of English proficiency is needed if English is not the first language; the procedures page says it may be waived for students whose primary language is English. Scores must be sent directly by the testing agency.

english.notes: Page lists 'TOEFL 3.5' without naming the scale; 3.5 can only be the new 1-6 scale. Older catalogs (2020-22) gave a 0-120 minimum of 61, which the current pages no longer list.

cost.notes: Rates for Fall 2026-Spring 2027 on the tuition page: Maryland resident tuition $7,640, out-of-state tuition $23,306, fees $3,138, housing and meals $15,242 (depends on accommodation). The page lists no separate international rate (international students are non-residents, so the out-of-state rate is the one that can apply, but this is not stated). Regional rate $17,198 is for residents of nearby PA/VA/WV/OH counties only

aid.notes: Federal aid is not available to international students. Admissions merit scholarships screen all incoming first-year students automatically, but the online merit calculator says awards for international students are not included, so international merit eligibility is unconfirmed. The Harold R. Rowe International Student Scholarship (GPA 2.5+, preference for financial need; deadlines July 1 for fall and October 15 for spring) is open to enrolled or accepted full-time international students; no amount is published.
